evidence.claim: MODES ha 22 store tra Italia, Francia e Svizzera, con sede a Milano e una rete di boutique multimarca, negozi per bambini e franchising monomarca.
evidence.quote: Headquartered in Milan and present in Italy, France, and Switzerland, MODES currently counts 22 stores. Eleven are signature multi-brand boutiques, specialized in menswear, womenswear, and accessories from today's most relevant designers. Four are MINIMODES multi-brand boutiques dedicated to children, and seven are mono-brand franchises.
